intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Pasta-primavera and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Pasta primavera typically contains pasta made from wheat, which poses a gluten risk for individuals with coeliac disease. Cross-contamination during preparation can also be a concern.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.body: Pasta-primavera can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.
